```sql
SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    u.Location
FROM main.users u
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        p_answer.OwnerUserId,
        COUNT(*) as accepted_count
    FROM main.posts p_question
    JOIN main.posts p_answer ON p_question.AcceptedAnswerId = p_answer.Id
    WHERE p_question.PostTypeId = 1
      AND p_answer.PostTypeId = 2
      AND p_question.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p_answer.CreaionDate) = '2013-06-01'
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', p_question.CreaionDate) = '2013-06-01'
    GROUP BY p_answer.OwnerUserId
    ORDER BY accepted_count DESC
    LIMIT 10
) top_users ON u.Id = top_users.OwnerUserId
ORDER BY top_users.accepted_count DESC
```
